en: The Couple consisting of Being Conjoined With, Produced By, and Coexistent With Mind; the Triplet of the Wholesome.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is conjoined with, originated by, and co-existent with consciousness (*cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhāna-sahabhū*), there arises a non-wholesome state that is not conjoined with, originated by, or co-existent with consciousness, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*)... Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is conjoined with, originated by, and co-existent with consciousness, there arises a non-unwholesome state that is not conjoined with, originated by, or co-existent with consciousness, by way of root condition...
Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance. (The Indeterminate Root)
(There are exactly three [types of nutriment] by way of condition.)
